title: Business Systems Analyst
text: Business Systems Analyst at Integrity Executive (Perth, CBD, Inner & Western Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Business Systems Analyst Short term contract Good hourly rate North of River Integrity is a West Australian owned and operated recruitment and staffing agency, with over 20 years’ experience in the WA marketplace. We provide permanent and temporary recruitment solutions, as well as HR services and consultancy to the WA State Government, Not-for-Profit Sector and Private Industry throughout WA We are looking for an experienced Business Systems Analyst to provide support to software system procurement and implementation projects within the clients software renewal program, to include: Stakeholder engagement and consultation Functional requirements analysis and documentation Process analysis and current and future state documentation Establishment of KPIs for software solutions Based NOR the: Key areas of accountability: Work in partnership with relative business units to identify, assess and scope enhancements to corporate information systems. Provide expert advice to the business units regarding information systems and their capability to optimise business processes. Proactively identify and document opportunities to increase organisational efficiency through the development of business information systems. Proactively increase organisational capability by identifying and exploiting opportunities for integration and co-working between enterprise business systems. Take responsibility for the successful delivery of information systems implementation projects, potentially including project scoping; development of business case; requirements analysis; solution design; liaison with software providers; system configuration and testing; data conversion; change management and project reporting. Coordinate user acceptance testing and regression testing of version upgrades, patches and hotfixes, ensuring that test outcomes are appropriately documented and issues managed. Design and develop management information reports and reporting frameworks as required to ensure that management and operational staff have access to timely and accurate business information. Take responsibility for the assessment, investigation and resolution of user queries and support issues. Liaise with external software and service providers to ensure that project and support task deliverables are achieved. Contribute to the development and maintenance of policies, procedures and other documentation related to the development and support of corporate information systems. Maintain a good understanding of the clients enterprise architecture and business processes. Undertake other activities including undergoing training and development as required for execution of the role. Comply with all client policies and procedures and relevant legislation. Exercise duty of care in line with Occupational Safety and Health policies You will need: Tertiary level information technology qualification or certification or equivalent experience. Extensive experience in implementing and supporting business information systems. Experience in business process analysis. Experience in specialist information system reporting. Highly developed communication and customer service skills. Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills. Experience in local government systems or a related sector(preferred but not essential) Up to date knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server or similar enterprise relational database system. Experience of Web technologies e.g. HTML5, CSS and scripting. Current 'C' class vehicle licence. If you meet the above requirements and available asap please Apply now ; please note that only candidates deemed suitable will be contacted in the first instance,thank you Level 2, 68 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 6000 Phone: 1300 730 762 Fax: (08) 9481 4577 www.integritystaffing.net.au
